outcome.label: No elite breakfast entitlement
outcome.detail: Breakfast may be included by the booked rate or property; status alone provides none.

outcome.label: Breakfast as welcome choice
outcome.detail: Select restaurant breakfast for the member and one room-sharing guest each night instead of points or an amenity.

outcome.label: No elite breakfast entitlement
outcome.detail: The welcome gift is points; a breakfast-inclusive rate can still include meals.

outcome.label: Breakfast as welcome choice
outcome.detail: Restaurant breakfast for member +1 each night is an available welcome choice at resorts.

outcome.label: Lounge breakfast / regional alternative
outcome.detail: At an eligible non-resort lounge, breakfast depends on the published offering and hours. US/Canada and Europe have specified breakfast-or-750-points alternatives; confirm venue and choice.

outcome.label: No elite lounge entitlement
outcome.detail: A qualifying room or paid access may offer entry.

outcome.label: No program lounge access
outcome.detail: The program does not grant lounge entry at this brand. Physical lounge presence and paid access are separate.

outcome.label: Resorts excluded from lounge guarantee
outcome.detail: A property may publish a separate access offering.

outcome.label: Elite lounge access, member +1
outcome.detail: Entry during normal operating hours for the member and one guest in the same room.

outcome.label: No physical lounge recorded
outcome.detail: US/Canada and Europe may provide breakfast or 750 points per night under the program alternative.

outcome.label: Club access requires a qualifying booking
outcome.detail: Elite status and a complimentary room or suite upgrade do not grant Ritz-Carlton Club access.

outcome.label: Premium club access unknown
outcome.detail: An executive lounge entitlement does not establish access to every premium club product.

outcome.label: No elite upgrade entitlement
outcome.detail: Any courtesy upgrade remains at property discretion.

outcome.label: Enhanced room, subject to availability
outcome.detail: Gold enhanced rooms are assessed at arrival; suites are not specified as a Gold entitlement.

outcome.label: Enhanced room, subject to availability
outcome.detail: Applies to the personal room for the full stay, as available on arrival. The current terms include suites at Platinum and above; Ritz-Carlton direct Club access is excluded. No upgrade probability is assumed.

outcome.label: No elite upgrade entitlement
outcome.detail: Any courtesy upgrade remains at property discretion.

outcome.label: No suite entitlement at Gold
outcome.detail: Gold enhanced rooms are assessed at arrival; suites are not specified as a Gold entitlement.

outcome.label: Select suites, subject to availability
outcome.detail: Applies to the personal room for the full stay, as available on arrival. The current terms include suites at Platinum and above; Ritz-Carlton direct Club access is excluded. No upgrade probability is assumed.

outcome.label: No elite late checkout
outcome.detail: Request any courtesy extension from the hotel.

outcome.label: Priority late checkout request
outcome.detail: Request on the departure morning; no specific time is guaranteed.

outcome.label: Up to 2 p.m., if available
outcome.detail: Request on the morning of checkout.

outcome.label: 4 p.m. guaranteed under standard rules
outcome.detail: Applies at properties confirmed to be neither a resort nor a convention hotel.

outcome.label: Up to 4 p.m., if available
outcome.detail: Resort and convention hotel checkout depends on availability.

outcome.label: Up to 4 p.m., if available
outcome.detail: Resort and convention hotel checkout depends on availability.

outcome.label: No elite welcome gift
outcome.detail: Paid packages and courtesy amenities are separate.

outcome.label: 500 points per stay
outcome.detail: The Gold gift is once per stay for these six catalog brands.

outcome.label: 1,000 points per stay
outcome.detail: No restaurant breakfast choice is supplied by this welcome rule.

outcome.label: 1,000 points, amenity or breakfast
outcome.detail: Choose one; breakfast covers member +1 each night, including resorts.

outcome.label: 1,000 points or $10 F&B credit per stay
outcome.detail: US, Canada and Europe; credit is per stay, not per night.

outcome.label: 1,000 points or F&B amenity
outcome.detail: Outside US, Canada and Europe; once per stay.

outcome.label: 1,000 points or nightly breakfast
outcome.detail: US, Canada and Europe resorts; breakfast for member +1.

outcome.label: 1,000 points, F&B amenity or breakfast
outcome.detail: Other-region resorts; nightly breakfast for member +1.

outcome.label: Ambassador only
outcome.detail: Status is manually entered; account entitlement is not checked.

outcome.label: Your24 request, subject to approval
outcome.detail: Request through Ambassador Service by 3 p.m. hotel time two days before arrival; approval sets matching check-in and checkout times for one room.

outcome.label: Titanium / Ambassador only
outcome.detail: This is not an award availability guarantee.

outcome.label: Resorts excluded
outcome.detail: 48-hour guaranteed availability is unavailable at resorts.

outcome.label: 25 rooms or fewer excluded
outcome.detail: Small properties are excluded even if sold out.

outcome.label: 48-hour paid-room guarantee with restrictions
outcome.detail: Book a standard personal room by 3 p.m. hotel time at least 48 hours before arrival; limited-date exclusions apply. Prevailing rates and length-of-stay restrictions apply; awards and discounted/promotional rates are excluded.
